visual.general_description: Schematic diagram with a mushroom illustration, two labeled boxes with LD50 values, two receptor drawings and arrows leading to EXCITATION and INHIBITION and a final syndrome name.
visual.detailed_description: Illustration on a pale cream background. The title Amanita muscaria is printed in bold italics at the top right, with a red-capped white-spotted mushroom drawing at the upper left. Two horizontal arrows run from the mushroom stem area to two boxes: a light blue box reading Ibotenic acid (IA) with LD50 (p.o.) in rats ~ 129 mg/kg and a light purple box reading Muscimol (M) with LD50 (p.o.) in rats ~ 45 mg/kg. Below are two circles, IA (blue) and M (purple). A downward arrow leads from each circle to a Y-shaped receptor drawing, blue for IA and purple for M, each sitting on a tan oval. The blue oval is labeled NMDA RECEPTOR and the purple oval GABA-A RECEPTOR. A downward arrow from each oval label leads to a box, EXCITATION (blue) under the NMDA receptor and INHIBITION (purple) under the GABA-A receptor. A wide tan downward block arrow below both boxes points to the bold text Pantherina-muscaria syndrome at the bottom.

visual.general_description: Color-coded flowchart with blue question boxes, orange NO and green YES boxes and yellow outcome boxes naming probable mushroom poisoning groups.
visual.detailed_description: Flowchart on a white background. A purple box reading Start of the algorithm at the top left leads down to a blue question box "Are there any GIT effects?". Blue question boxes include "Onset of effects < 6 h", "Develop neurologic effects?", "Are there neurologic effects?", "Is the urine purple?", two boxes beginning "Initial drowsiness, then ataxia, agitation alternating stupor, may be manic, exhibit bizarre behavior?", "Rapid onset (10 – 30 mins) visual/auditory/tactile illusions, hallucinations?" and "Rapid onset (15 – 120 mins) of sweating, salivation, lacrimation", with the word salivation in red underlined text, and one box ending "feeling of mystical experience?" with the last words in red underlined text. Small orange NO boxes and green YES boxes sit on the connecting arrows. Yellow outcome boxes read Probably Group 2C (muscimol/ibotenic acid) twice, Probably Group 2A (psilocybins) twice, Probably Group 2B (muscarines), Probably Group 4C (polyporic acid), and four boxes listing other group numbers or uncertain diagnoses. Black arrows connect all boxes.
